items.title: 68642_Jo Jones oral history interview
items.q: and Miller and Lyles and all that.

ctx.x: You just mentioned Ethel Waters and Ma Rainey had a show. These were black shows... We just want it for the records so that the reader and the listener will know that these were great shows - and the Whitman Sisters -

I met in 1923, I met Butterbeans and Suzie and I was running errands and getting their food at the Frolic Theatre in Birmingham, Alabama. That's authenticated and truthfully. Everything that is really in show business, and Miller and Lyles and all that.
